title: Tidepool Keeper - A calm idle rock-pool garden
short: Plant sea life by who likes whom and watch your rock pool grow, even while you're away.
desc:
Look after a rock pool by the sea. Tap the water to stir up plankton, then plant kelp, periwinkles, anemones, sponges, urchins, coral, sea stars and lantern jellies on twenty rocks.

· Every creature has a neighbour it likes and grows 1.5 times faster right next to it, so where you plant things matters.
· While the app is closed the pool keeps gathering plankton for up to 8 hours.
· Twelve visitors, from gobies and seahorses to a sea turtle, arrive and stay in your guide, and each one makes everything grow faster.
· A daily tide doubles one species, and finishing the daily task gives you a pearl and a calendar stamp.
· Release the pool to the sea to collect pearls and start a faster new round.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
